visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older man wearing a pink long-sleeved shirt, a dark vest, and a white apron decorated with French motifs like the Eiffel Tower and macarons stands by a bookshelf filled with colorful books. A red caption overlay appears in the center. (2) The man stands in a modern, well-lit living room with neutral-toned walls and a marble-patterned backsplash. He looks down at his apron and adjusts the fabric with a yellow cloth in his hand. (3) The man walks across the wooden floor towards a dining area, then turns back to face the camera, smiling and laughing with squinted eyes. He holds a yellow cleaning cloth. (4) A ginger and white tabby cat is seen resting on someone's lap wearing grey pants, then the cat jumps down and walks away on the light brown wooden floor. Yellow captions appear at the top.

(2) The female voice laughs naturally (low-intensity crowd noise) while continuing to praise the man's appearance in the apron. (3) A cartoonish 'ding' sound effect plays at the peak of the joke as the man smiles at the camera. (4) The BGM continues steadily as the female voice gives a final playful command to go to work. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To capture and share a humorous and endearing domestic moment where a husband playfully wears his wife's feminine apron to start his 'work day' (housework), showcasing their warm relationship.
